Guild listing: Dark Matter. Published by Phoenix Collective (Falkor's team) from the guild's own public text, supplied by the Founder.

Leader: @[HEIM] CapThor head of council

Our aim is to live and thrive in the high risk zone, we protect our own

Faction is family
The Pirate Council Rules
Our word is our bond!
Fair shares for all!
Resistance is futile!
One for all and all for one!.
We look after our friends
Laggards walk the plank!.
We're all in it together!
Pirates just wanna have fun.
